(6 goals each) | prevseason = | nextseason = [[2021 Copa de la Liga Profesional|2021]] }} The '''2020 Copa de la Liga Profesional''' (officially '''Copa Diego Armando Maradona'''){{cite web |url=https://www.ligaprofesional.ar/2020/11/25/institucional/copa-diego-maradona/ |title=Copa Diego Maradona |publisher=Liga Profesional de Fútbol |date=25 November 2020 |language=Spanish |access-date=2 February 2021 |archive-date=23 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210123201139/https://www.ligaprofesional.ar/2020/11/25/institucional/copa-diego-maradona/ |url-status=dead }} was the first edition of the [[Copa de la Liga Profesional]], an [[list of Argentine football national cups|Argentine domestic cup]] contested by the 24 teams that took part in the [[Argentine Primera División|Primera División]] during the [[2019–20 Argentine Primera División|2019–20 season]]. The tournament was named after [[Diego Maradona]].{{cite web |url=https://www.ligaprofesional.ar/institucional/noticia/hasta-siempre-diego |title=Hasta siempre, Diego |publisher=Liga Profesional de Fútbol |date=25 November 2020 |language=Spanish |access-date=26 November 2020 |archive-date=4 December 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201204005211/https://www.ligaprofesional.ar/institucional/noticia/hasta-siempre-diego |url-status=dead }} The competition started on 30 October 2020 and ended on 31 March 2021.{{cite web |url=https://www.ligaprofesional.ar/institucional/noticia/vuelve-el-futbol |title=¡Vuelve el fútbol! |publisher=Liga Profesional de Fútbol |date=14 October 2020 |language=Spanish |access-date=18 October 2020 |archive-date=18 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201018090408/https://www.ligaprofesional.ar/institucional/noticia/vuelve-el-futbol |url-status=dead }} The competition was planned and organised by the "Liga Profesional de Fútbol", a body linked to the [[Argentine Football Association]] (AFA) that replaced the defunct [[Superliga Argentina (association)|Superliga Argentina]].{{cite web|url=https://www.pressreader.com/argentina/clarin/20200519/282089163964322 |title=Quién es quién en una AFA nueva que recupera los viejos poderes |publisher=Clarín |date=19 May 2020 |language=Spanish}} This cup was conceived as a contingency competition after the schedule for a regular league season had been repeatedly delayed because of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina|COVID-19 pandemic]]. [[Boca Juniors]] and [[Club Atlético Banfield|Banfield]] advanced to the Fase Campeón Final. Boca Juniors won the Final via a penalty shoot-out after the game had finished 1–1 and were crowned as champions of the cup.{{cite web |url=https://www.ligaprofesional.ar/2021/01/17/copa-diego-armando-maradona/buscando-al-campeon/ |title=Boca es el campeón |date=17 January 2021 |publisher=Liga Profesional de Fútbol |language=Spanish |access-date=18 January 2021 |archive-date=27 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210127103821/https://www.ligaprofesional.ar/2021/01/17/copa-diego-armando-maradona/buscando-al-campeon/ |url-status=dead }} As Boca Juniors had already qualified for the 2021 Copa Libertadores, [[San Lorenzo de Almagro|San Lorenzo]] (best team of the 2019–20 Superliga Argentina and 2020 Copa de la Superliga [[2019–20 Argentine Primera División#Aggregate table|aggregate table]] not yet qualified) gained the 2021 Copa Libertadores berth. ==Format== [[File:Copa lpf 20 logo.png|thumb|120px|Original logo of the cup, changed after the passing of [[Diego Maradona]]]] For the group stage, the 24 teams were drawn into six groups of four teams each, playing on a double [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. In each zone, the top two teams advanced to the "Fase Campeón" while the bottom two teams advanced to the "Fase Complementación".{{cite web|url=https://www.afa.com.ar/upload/NewFolder/NewFolder/NewFolder/5803%20-%20Reglamento%20Copa%20LPF%202020.pdf |title=REGLAMENTO DE LA COPA DE LA LIGA PROFESIONAL DE FUTBOL DE AFA 2020 |publisher=AFA |date=26 October 2020 |language=Spanish}} In the ''Fase Campeón'', the 12 qualified teams were split into two groups of six teams each, where they played a single round-robin tournament. The winners of each group played the final match at a neutral venue. The winners of the ''Fase Campeón'' final were crowned champions of the cup and qualified for the [[2021 Copa Libertadores]]. On the other hand, teams in ''Fase Complementación'' played under the same format as in the ''Fase Campeón''. The winners of the ''Fase Complementación'' final played a match against the ''Fase Campeón'' runners-up with the winners qualifying for the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana]]. ==Draws== The draw for the group stage was held on 16 October 2020, 14:00, at Complejo Habitacional de Ezeiza in [[Ezeiza, Buenos Aires|Ezeiza]].{{cite web Campeón== In the Fase Campeón, each group comprised three winners and three runners-up from the group stage. The groups were played on a single round-robin basis, with the group stage winners playing three home matches. Teams were ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Head-to-head points; 5. Head-to-head goal difference; 6. Head-to-head goals scored (Regulations Article 2.2). The Fase Campeón final match was played between the winners of each group at a neutral venue. If tied, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the champions (Regulations Article 2.2). The champions qualified for the 2021 Copa Libertadores. ===Group A=== {{#invoke:Sports table|main|style=WDL |section=Group A The groups were played on a single round-robin basis, with the third-placed teams playing three home matches. Teams were ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Head-to-head points; 5. Head-to-head goal difference; 6. Head-to-head goals scored (Regulations Article 2.3). The Fase Complementación final match was played between the winners of each group at a neutral venue. If tied, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winners (Regulations Articles 2.3). ===Group A=== {{#invoke:Sports table|main|style=WDL
